source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Νεομάρτυρας εκ Σερρών»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους» and closes «η μνήμη του γιορτάζεται στις 12 Μαΐου», twice the day of the listing. **He is not the day's other John**: [John the Wallachian](/saints/john-the-wallachian), whom the corpus already keeps on this same day, is a Wallachian of noble birth hanged at Constantinople in 1662, and this one is a rich man's son of Serres burnt there about 1480 — two men, two pages, two centuries, both on 12 May. **Nor is he any of the corpus's other Johns of the Turkish period.** **No hymn is printed**, although the page names the service's author, Manuel the Peloponnesian, Great Rhetor of the Great Church, who wrote it probably between 1491 and 1497. **No `locations` object**, although Serres is named throughout.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
